provider_duplication_finding._what: API-Football returns every injury record EXACTLY TWICE for MLS fixture 1490361: 26 array elements for 13 distinct players.
provider_duplication_finding.how_it_is_handled: Dedupe on (provider, subject_ref, player_key) collapses to 13 rows, and BOTH numbers stay on the read surface: record_count=26 (raw) beside stored_records=13 (distinct), so the 2x artefact stays visible rather than being silently absorbed.
provider_duplication_finding.why_it_matters: The brief for this build cited '26 records on NYCFC v Toronto' as the coverage figure. The honest figure is 13 absences. Reporting 26 would double-count every player, and any aggregate built on it would be wrong by 2x — one more reason this module builds no aggregate at all.
